europe_now.summary: At least nine people were killed during a missile attack on the Ukrainian capital. The strikes also resulted in 28 injuries.

europe_now.title: Wildfires spread across France and Greece
europe_now.summary: Major wildfires are burning in France and Greece despite containment efforts. Firefighters in France have managed to stop the spread of some fires, though they continue to burn.

top_stories.title: Migration Crisis in Ceuta
top_stories.summary: Spain has criticized EU partners for their response to the migrant influx in Ceuta. The enclave has seen significant border crossings, with 57 deaths reported.
